name: Jamtech Store AI Assistant for WooCommerce
author: Jamtech

sections.description:
Jamtech Store AI Assistant for WooCommerce adds an AI-powered chatbot to your store, helping customers get instant answers about products, pricing, availability, shipping, payment methods, and store policies.

The chatbot understands WooCommerce product information and can answer customer questions about products, pricing, stock availability, variations, shipping, payment methods, and FAQs.

The plugin also includes conversation tracking, lead management, analytics, and product insights to help store owners better understand customer interactions and improve product discovery.

Features

Multi AI Provider Support

Choose your preferred AI provider:

  • OpenAI
  • Google Gemini
  • Anthropic Claude
  • DeepSeek
  • Ollama (Self-hosted AI Models)

Product-Aware AI Responses

The chatbot automatically understands WooCommerce product information including:

  • Product name
  • Product description
  • Product pricing
  • Stock status
  • Product attributes
  • Product variations
  • Product FAQs

Intelligent Product Assistance

Customers can ask questions such as:

  • Is this product in stock?
  • What sizes are available?
  • What colors are available?
  • Do variations have different prices?
  • What payment methods do you accept?
  • How does shipping work?
  • What is your return policy?

Flexible Chat Placement

Display the chatbot on WooCommerce single product pages using:

  • Floating chat button
  • Above Add to Cart button
  • Below Add to Cart button
  • Sticky mobile widget

Product Visibility Controls

Control exactly where the chatbot appears:

  • Show on all products
  • Show only selected products
  • Hide on selected products

Smart Product Selector

Manage products efficiently with:

  • AJAX product search
  • Infinite scrolling
  • Product thumbnails
  • Product stock indicators

Conversation Tracking

Review and manage chatbot conversations directly from the WordPress admin dashboard.

  • Conversation history
  • Customer interaction tracking
  • AI response monitoring

Lead Management

Capture and manage customer leads generated through chatbot interactions.

  • Lead collection
  • Customer contact information
  • Inquiry tracking
  • Lead management dashboard

Analytics & Reporting

Monitor chatbot performance and customer engagement.

  • Chatbot usage analytics
  • Conversation metrics
  • Customer engagement insights
  • Performance reporting

Product Analytics

Understand how customers interact with products through the chatbot.

  • Product inquiry tracking
  • Product engagement insights
  • Most requested products
  • Product-specific analytics

Mobile Friendly

  • Fully responsive interface
  • Optimized for mobile devices
  • Sticky mobile chat support

WooCommerce HPOS Compatible

Jamtech Store AI Assistant for WooCommerce is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Supported AI Providers

OpenAI

Connect using your OpenAI API key and use supported OpenAI models.

Google Gemini

Use Google’s Gemini models for intelligent product assistance.

Anthropic Claude

Provide advanced conversational support with Claude.

DeepSeek

Use DeepSeek models as an alternative AI provider.

Ollama

Use locally hosted Ollama models running on your own server or network.

WooCommerce Integration

The plugin integrates directly with WooCommerce and can access:

  • Product information
  • Product pricing
  • Product inventory
  • Product attributes
  • Product variations
  • Product FAQs
  • Payment methods
  • Shipping configuration

This helps provide more accurate and relevant customer responses.

Compatibility

Jamtech Store AI Assistant for WooCommerce supports standard WordPress and WooCommerce installations.

The AI assistant currently supports customer conversations in:

  • English
  • French
  • Italian
  • German

Third-party multilingual plugins such as WPML are not currently supported.

Privacy

This plugin stores chatbot conversations and optional lead information (such as name, email address, and phone number) in the WordPress database to provide chatbot functionality, conversation history, analytics, and lead management.

When an AI provider is configured, customer messages and relevant product information are transmitted only to the selected AI provider to generate chatbot responses.

Site owners are responsible for complying with applicable privacy regulations, including GDPR and similar laws.

External Services

This plugin can connect to third-party AI services to generate chatbot responses. These services are optional and are only used when configured by the site administrator.

Data sent to the selected AI provider may include:

  • Customer messages submitted through the chatbot.
  • Product information required to generate contextual responses.
  • Store-specific configuration required for chatbot functionality.

OpenAI

Privacy Policy:

Google Gemini

Service: Google Gemini API

https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Anthropic Claude

Service: Anthropic Claude API

Terms of Service:
https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms

Privacy Policy:
https://www.anthropic.com/privacy

DeepSeek

Service: DeepSeek API

Terms of Service:
https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html

Privacy Policy:
https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html

Ollama

Ollama runs locally on the server and does not transmit data to a third-party service unless configured to use a remote model endpoint. Ollama is an optional local AI provider. No data is sent to third-party services when using a local Ollama server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/jamtech-store-ai-assistant-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Store AI Assistant.
  5. Select an AI provider.
  6. Enter your API key.
  7. Configure chatbot placement and visibility settings.
  8. Save settings.
sections.faq:
Which AI providers are supported?

OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, and Ollama.

Can I show the chatbot only on specific products?

Yes. Use Product Visibility settings to display or hide the chatbot on selected products.

Can I use different AI models?

Yes. Supported providers allow you to choose available models through plugin settings.

Does the plugin include analytics?

Yes. The plugin includes analytics and reporting tools to help monitor chatbot performance and customer engagement.

Can the chatbot capture leads?

Yes. The plugin includes lead capture functionality and a lead management dashboard.

Can I review customer conversations?

Yes. Chatbot conversations can be reviewed from the Conversations section in the admin dashboard.

Which languages does the AI assistant support?

The AI assistant currently supports customer conversations in English, French, Italian, and German.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Tested and confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.1.
  • Improved frontend JavaScript isolation to prevent conflicts with WordPress global variables.
  • Improved chatbot mounting reliability on WooCommerce single product pages.
  • Updated product pricing to respect WooCommerce tax display settings.
  • Improved multilingual AI responses for English, French, Italian, and German.
  • Improved multilingual intent detection for supported customer languages.
  • Clarified that WPML integration is not currently supported.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • AI-powered WooCommerce shopping assistant.
  • OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, and Ollama support.
  • Product-aware chatbot.
  • Lead capture and conversation management.
  • Analytics dashboard.
  • Product analytics.
  • Product visibility controls.
  • Multiple chatbot placement options.
  • AJAX product selector.
  • Responsive interface.
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.
